description: This file defines an internal interface 'IActivationRebalancerMonitor' within the Orleans project, specifically in the Placement.Rebalancing namespace. It serves as a monitor for activation rebalancing, exposing a reporting method and a periodic report interval.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancerMonitor
classes.description: An internal interface for monitoring activation rebalancing, implementing ISystemTarget and IActivationRebalancer, with a static report period and a reporting method.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: An asynchronous method invoked periodically by the IActivationRebalancerWorker to send a RebalancingReport.
